# Get-ZbxHostPrototype

## SYNOPSIS

Gets the host prototypes that discovery rules turn into hosts.

## SYNTAX

### All (Default)

```
Get-ZbxHostPrototype [-Limit <int>] [-SortField <string[]>] [-Id <ulong[]>] [-Discovery <ZabbixReference<ZabbixDiscoveryRule>[]>] [-SelectGroupLinks] [-SelectGroupPrototypes] [-SelectDiscoveryRule] [-SelectParentHost] [-SelectInterfaces] [-SelectTemplates] [-SelectMacros] [-SelectTags] [-SelectDiscoveryRulePrototype] [-SelectDiscoveryData] [-SelectInheritedTags] [-Editable] [-InputObject <PSObject>] [-SortOrder <ZabbixSortOrder[]>] [-Search <Hashtable>] [-SearchByAny] [-StartSearch] [-ExcludeSearch] [-SearchWildcardsEnabled] [-CountOutput] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-First <UInt64>] [-Skip <UInt64>] [-IncludeTotalCount] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A host prototype is the pattern a discovery rule turns into one host per entity it finds, such as a virtual machine of a hypervisor. The Get-ZbxHostPrototype cmdlet reads them with hostprototype.get: all of them up to -Limit, by name with -Name (* and ? are wildcards), by id with -Id or from the pipeline, or with the whole hostprototype.get selection in -Filter. -Discovery narrows the result to the host prototypes of the given discovery rules, each a name, an id or a piped object. It writes ZabbixHostPrototype objects, with their related objects when a -Select switch asks for them, or, with -CountOutput, the number of matches; it needs a connection made with Connect-ZbxServer.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Get a host prototype by name

```powershell
Get-ZbxHostPrototype -Name '{#VM.NAME}'
```

Gets the host prototype named {#VM.NAME}. A * or ? in -Name makes it a search.

### Example 2: Get the host prototypes of a discovery rule

```powershell
Get-ZbxHostPrototype -Discovery 'Mounted filesystems'
```

Gets the host prototypes of the discovery rule Mounted filesystems. -Discovery takes a name, an id or an object; a discovery rule piped from Get-ZbxDiscoveryRule binds to it by its DiscoveryId property.

### Example 3: Count host prototypes

```powershell
Get-ZbxHostPrototype -CountOutput
```

Writes how many host prototypes the server has, without reading them.

## INPUTS

- `ulong[]`: Bound to -Id (ByPropertyName).
- `ZabbixReference<ZabbixDiscoveryRule>[]`: Bound to -Discovery (ByPropertyName). Represents a reference to an API object: a parameter that points at an API object takes its id, its name, or the object itself piped from a Get- cmdlet, and becomes an id before the call — one parameter, three spellings, one resolution.
- `PSObject`: Bound to -InputObject (ByValue). Each object as the API answers it.

## OUTPUTS

- `ZabbixHostPrototype`: The host prototype read model, as returned by the Zabbix API.
